I told Pree in her DM that her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October. That's what she told me on 14 October, and she hasn't changed it since.

The date came from the DM history, not from memory. When I looked for the note I saved on 14 October, memory came back empty, both by her name and by searching the topic. I can't tell whether the note was never kept or just can't be read back from here. Either way, it can't be counted on for future reminders.

Separately, the DM history shows that my wrap-up from last time ended up as a message in Pree's DM. It's harmless, since it only repeats her own date back to her, but it wasn't meant for her.
